66b4458a3d.headline: Digital Foundry: GTA 6 runs steadier on Series X than base PS5
66b4458a3d.full_caption:
Console showdown! 🎮 Digital Foundry's new performance analysis says Xbox Series X holds GTA 6's 30fps target more consistently than the base PS5. PS5 Pro takes the overall lead, with the most stable performance and the sharpest image of the four consoles. Swipe for the full breakdown.

Which console are you playing GTA 6 on, and have you noticed any dips?

Source: Eurogamer

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GrandTheftAutoVI #RockstarGames #DigitalFoundry #PS5 #PS5Pro #XboxSeriesX #GamingNews #LeonidaDaily
66b4458a3d.alt_text: News graphic comparing GTA 6 frame-rate performance on Xbox Series X, PS5 and PS5 Pro, based on a Digital Foundry analysis.

slides.title: The verdict
slides.text: Digital Foundry's analysis finds that Xbox Series X keeps GTA 6's 30fps target more consistently than the base PS5.

slides.title: Where the dips happen
slides.text: Both base consoles often hit 30fps. Drops show up in busy crowds and fast vehicle traversal, sometimes falling to the mid-to-high 20s.

slides.title: Series X edge
slides.text: PS5 has substantially more frequent drops than Series X. Series X also supports 120Hz VRR, which helps smooth out small dips.

slides.title: PS5 Pro leads the pack
slides.text: PS5 Pro has the most stable 30fps of all four consoles. It looks sharper at 4K thanks to PSSR upscaling from a 1440p base. It has no 60fps or 40fps modes.

eee0021317.headline: How to flip your car back over in GTA 6
eee0021317.full_caption:
Rolled your ride in GTA 6? No need to panic. 🚗

Walk into the side of the upturned car until your character starts a pushing animation, then shove it back onto its wheels. In races you can't leave the car, so there's a quick reset button instead. Swipe for the exact controls.

What's the wildest crash you've had so far?

Source: VGC

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GrandTheftAutoVI #GTA6Tips #GTA6Guide #Leonida #JasonAndLucia #RockstarGames #GamingTips #OpenWorld
eee0021317.alt_text: Graphic with the headline 'How to flip your car back over in GTA 6' for a tips and tricks guide.

slides.title: Flipped in the open world
slides.text: Walk into the side of your upturned car as Jason or Lucia until your character switches to a pushing animation. You need to push from the side for this to work.

slides.title: Shove it back
slides.text: While pushing, press X on Xbox or Square on PS5 to shove. Your character should have enough strength to tip the car back onto its wheels.

slides.title: Bonus: beached boats
slides.text: The same technique can push a boat stuck on the shore back into the water.

slides.title: Crashed in a race?
slides.text: You can't leave your vehicle in a race. Hold Back (Xbox) or Touch Pad (PS5) to reset onto the road facing the right way. If the race is ruined, pick Restart Event in the pause menu.

e668bb75ea.headline: GTA 6 Bank Vaults: The Trick to Cracking Them Open
e668bb75ea.full_caption:
Want a $100,000+ score in GTA 6? Skip the drill and let the armored car driver do the work. 🏦

Vault doors can't be forced in open-world bank jobs. A guard from an armored car has to open one for you, so tail the truck, wait until he's deep inside, then make your move. Swipe for the full plan.

What's your go-to getaway car after a big bank job? 🚗

Source: PC Gamer

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAutoVI #GTAVI #ViceCity #Leonida #RockstarGames #GTA6Tips #GTA6Guide #BankHeist #JasonAndLucia
e668bb75ea.alt_text: Graphic with the headline 'GTA 6 Bank Vaults: The Trick to Cracking Them Open' announcing a guide to big bank jobs in Vice City.

slides.title: The vault trick
slides.text: Vault doors can't be broken into during open-world bank robberies. Only an armored car driver can open one. Follow him in, wait until he's deep inside the bank, then start the robbery.

slides.title: Finding an armored car
slides.text: Patrol near banks with vaults, or pay fence Yasmani $10,000 for a tip that marks two armored cars with pink map icons. The Robberies tab lists every big bank on your map.

slides.title: Grab the bonus loot
slides.text: Shoot safe deposit boxes open, or blow them all at once with a grenade or sticky bomb. Also hit the cash drawers and safes. Stick a bomb on the armored car's rear door so it can't despawn.

slides.title: Pro tips for the job
slides.text: Bring both Jason and Lucia to carry up to four bags. Use silenced weapons and shoot out the cloud cameras. An alarm means an instant four-star wanted level, so plan your escape first.

7d5ffc8151.headline: Marbelle Hotel: Silent Hill Easter Egg and Safe Code
7d5ffc8151.full_caption:
Vice City has a creepy secret, and it's hiding in an abandoned hotel. 🌫️

The Marbelle Hotel in southern Crosstown hides a Silent Hill-inspired Easter egg with flickering lights, strange symbols and fog over the city. Finish it and you can open a safe on the ground floor for a cash and watch reward.

Swipe for the location, the trigger steps and the code.

Will you brave the Marbelle Hotel solo or with a friend?

Source: VGC

#GTAVI #GTA6 #ViceCity #Leonida #RockstarGames #GTA6Guide #EasterEgg #SilentHill #GamingNews #GTAcommunity
7d5ffc8151.alt_text: Graphic about the Marbelle Hotel, an abandoned Vice City building hiding a Silent Hill-inspired Easter egg and a safe in GTA 6.

slides.title: Where to find the Marbelle Hotel
slides.text: It's in southern Crosstown, Vice City, on NW 8th Street near the Nine1Nine nightclub, about a block east of Pawn & Gun. Look for boarded windows and a For Sale sign.

slides.title: Getting inside
slides.text: The front door is locked, so go around to the back and use the accessible door. The safe you're after is on the ground floor.

slides.title: Triggering the Easter egg
slides.text: Head upstairs until a door opens by itself, then keep going towards the roof. Lights flicker out, red symbols appear and whispers play. Kick down the roof door to see Vice City covered in fog.

slides.title: Safe code and rewards
slides.text: The Old Note on the roof has the six-digit code circled: 955214. The safe holds cash and a Crowex Ambassador 'Breakfast' watch.

93abd9950a.headline: GTA 6 guide: Free garage and pink Growler in LaPerle
93abd9950a.full_caption:
A free garage and a hot pink supercar are waiting in LaPerle 🔑

The spot is Auntie's Place, a background restaurant that never shows on your map. Find the white building behind it, punch the code into the keypad by the garage door, and the Del Rio Boulevard Garage is yours, with a Pfister Growler inside. Keep the car, or sell it and use the garage for another ride.

Swipe for the exact directions. Will you keep the pink Growler or sell it?

Source: VGC

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #GTAVI #ViceCity #LaPerle #Leonida #GTA6Guide #GTA6Tips #RockstarGames #Gaming
93abd9950a.alt_text: Graphic with the headline about a free garage and hot pink Pfister Growler hidden in LaPerle, Vice City, in Grand Theft Auto 6.

slides.title: Where is Auntie's Place?
slides.text: It's in LaPerle, a Vice City district, and it isn't marked on your map even once you've found it. Don't confuse it with Aunt Zola's Soul Food, which is a different restaurant.

slides.title: How to spot it
slides.text: Auntie's Place is a background restaurant you can't enter. Look across the road, to the East, from Twa Ponya Tattoo and behind Aline's Thrift Store. It's a block West of Tyrone's place.

slides.title: The garage and the code
slides.text: Behind the restaurant is a white building with a locked garage door. Enter 92665 on the keypad next to it to unlock the Del Rio Boulevard Garage for free.

slides.title: What you get
slides.text: Inside is a hot pink Pfister Growler. Keep it, or sell it and use the garage to store an extra vehicle.

queue.headline: GTA 6 Sniper Scope Trick Turns Angry NPCs Into $2,000 Payouts
queue.full_caption:
Scoping random pedestrians in GTA 6 can turn one of them into a very persistent problem, and a profitable one. 🎯

Keep your sniper zoomed on an NPC and they may spot you from hundreds of meters away, make a throat-slash gesture and sprint straight at you. Guns reportedly stop working on them, but beating one earns $2,000. Streamer CausticCorro showed a fist fight doing the job.

The report expects Rockstar to patch it, so treat it as a find, not a permanent strategy.

Would you take the fist fight or throw them off a wall?

Source: GamesRadar+

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAutoVI #GTAVI #Leonida #RockstarGames #GTA6Tips #GTA6Money #GamingNews #CausticCorro #GTACommunity
queue.alt_text: Graphic with the headline about a GTA 6 sniper scope trick that makes NPCs hunt the player and pay out $2,000 when beaten.

slides.title: The sniper scope trigger
slides.text: Zoom in on ordinary NPCs with your sniper rifle in GTA 6 and some will notice, even from hundreds of meters away. They respond by drawing a thumb across their neck.

slides.title: Then they come for you
slides.text: The NPC sprints straight at your position and keeps coming until it finds you. Once it arrives, it is described as practically invincible.

slides.title: How players beat them
slides.text: In CausticCorro's clip, the NPC tracks them across Leonida at night and shrugs off gunfire. Only a fist fight finishes it. Another method is luring them up high and throwing them over a wall.

slides.title: The payout, and a warning
slides.text: Each win earns $2,000. GamesRadar+ expects Rockstar to patch this quickly, so it may not last.
